reviews.text: Late at night, I noticed my cat was going to the litter box frequently but only peeing a little bit each time. Thankfully, we found a very professional vet working the night shift. He clearly explained the diagnosis and patiently answered all my questions.

My cat has been vaccinated and sterilized here since birth. Some time ago, my cat felt lethargic and had a poor appetite. I took her to this hospital, but the doctor didn't examine her and didn't even allow her to leave the kennel. He casually prescribed some medication. Later we went to another hospital and the doctors were very kind and responsible. They gave the cat fluids and my cat recovered quickly.

Thank you again for everything.

I've used your services twice before, and this time it was for a different child.

I noticed my child's eye was red, and my regular vet was closed, so this hospital immediately came to mind.

I called and explained the symptoms, and they said they could see him, so I went right away.

Just hearing that it wasn't an eye injury was a huge relief.

The swelling has subsided since we got home.

Thank you so much for seeing him so quickly.

I'll contact you again if anything comes up!

Hospitals that offer nighttime consultations are invaluable.

I hope we never have to use your services, but I hope you continue to provide them for emergencies.

First of all, thank you, Doctor.

It was past 9 PM and my regular doctor's office was closed, so I was anxious and called a 24-hour hospital. Despite the sudden call, you kindly saw me and provided very kind and thorough care. I am truly grateful.

Thanks to you, I feel much more at ease. Thank you so much.

I would definitely like to use your services again if my regular doctor's office is closed or outside of business hours. I look forward to your continued support.

My beloved dog, who has a heart condition, suddenly took a turn for the worse, so I took him to this clinic, which is close to my home and is open at night.

I was impressed by the doctor's experience. They kept him overnight, and he came back recovered. Thank you very much.

When choosing a new hospital, I usually check reviews to some extent. There were no concerns mentioned in the reviews, and the fees were not high at all; they were very reasonable.

I imagine it's incredibly difficult to instantly assess the condition of pets that aren't regular vets and find a treatment plan. I also imagine there are days when they have to deal with the harsh reviews from anxious pet owners. Despite all that, I really admire their nighttime service. I hope they continue to do their best.

As I've written to other pet owners, please consider this before you go.

If you dislike foreign pet owners, please state that on your website or elsewhere. You are welcome to speak in Japanese, but
please be gentle with the animals.

----------------------------------
This comment is written for pet owners who love their pets.
This is my second visit. When my cat was a kitten, she had a head injury and was bleeding, and you treated her in the middle of the night. I was very grateful then.
The problem arose on my second visit. My other cat, who is suffering from cancer, was injured and undergoing chemotherapy, so we couldn't easily decide how to handle the situation. This isn't because I doubt the doctor's expertise, but because pet owners have the right to ask why a doctor who has never treated a patient before is taking such action. In this situation, when I asked for opinions from other hospitals and my cat's primary veterinarian, they told me to leave, even though there were no other patients waiting.

Afterward, I was finally able to contact my regular emergency veterinary clinic, and they confirmed that the procedure was safe. However, a significant amount of medication leaked when the needle was inserted into the cat. Also, the nurse said that the medication details were listed on the invoice, but it was later discovered that the name of the injected medication was not included.

The next day, I contacted my primary veterinarian, who confirmed that what the doctor here had done was 70% correct, but that disinfecting the wound should have been a priority, and that this had not been done. The leakage of the medication is also a concern.

I understand that this doctor created a 24-hour hospital out of love for animals. I also heard that they are involved in rescue activities. Therefore, it is extremely disappointing that they would prioritize the owner's background and actions over the animal's well-being. Also, as other pet owners have said, if you love animals and stay up all night taking care of them, then treating them poorly is counterproductive.

I understand that some pet owners have made positive comments. However, from a risk management perspective, I would never want to take my own pet there again.
